title: Page 51
transc:
Washington April 6 . 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Growl Henrietta April pledge for Knox Zebra the Bolivia
directs me to acknowledge receipt of your despatch of
this morning and to say that you will submit
by letter or telegram to the Brutus the vernons
in relation to the exchange of prisoners where in
you wish instructions & that it is not Tartar
you to visit grapes for the purpose indicated youth
John hay Tappan & A A G fine day
Thos T. Eckert


Ft Monroe April 6 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Growl April plague Jennie for lent pandora Biggs vinton appian
send Salvor to Ann a pole is if still at
Animal & not under Engagements making the trip a serious
loss unity order a purple tons of coal a float
at appian if it can be spared to hill town
head advise me how much you can send that I
may replace it from the torrent yoke Meigs vinton shelter
Thos T Eckert


Ft Monroe April 6th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Tappan John Hay assistant Barton grapes
Zodiac wrangle received zebra Vernons will be
submitted unity I beg leave to assure
Bologna that I have no desire to
visit Growl but a wish he should
visit Animal as Expressed in my wreathe
of Saturday Youth Knox weather still unsettled
Geo D Sheldon
